articles.title: US pulls boys team from FIFA Under-17 World Cup in Qatar citing security in the Gulf
articles.description: The United States soccer body has pulled its team from the boys’ Under-17 World Cup in Qatar starting next week for security reasons. FIFA has confirmed the U.S. Soccer Federation decision on Thursday. Qatar and the Gulf region has been on high security alert since the United States military attacks on Iran started in February. The 48-nation FIFA tournament kicks off in Doha next Wednesday. The U.S. team’s scheduled first game was Nov. 21 against Montenegro. Its other opponents were Chile and Algeria. FIFA cites the "existing US Level 3 travel advisory.” No replacement team was named.
